note: Two independent, public distributions reproduce the routing conclusion: external benign instructions are diverted at 14.3% and public jailbreaks are detected at 99.6%. A fully independent production deployment is not available -> stated as a single-deployment limitation. External benign instructions over-flag at 0.5 (73.0%) far above the in-distribution benign rate (25.7%): the router over-scores terse instruction-style questions, consistent with the paper's 'instruction-style benign over-scores' caveat and motivating the per-deployment recalibration recipe.
